verdict.rationale: Manufact documents an official CLI. It can build and run MCP servers locally with hot reload and an inspector, deploy to Manufact Cloud, and manage servers, deployments, and environment variables from the terminal. A probe confirms the official CLI docs exist. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and evidence of AI-native features such as machine-readable output or agent-oriented usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: build and run MCP servers locally, deploy them to Manufact Cloud, and manage servers, deployments, and environment variables without leaving the terminal.
